recovery.title: Recovery After Hospital Stay
recovery.metaTitle: Recovery After Hospital Stay | Movement Science Physiotherapy
recovery.metaDescription: Transition smoothly from hospital to home with specialist physiotherapy support. Regain independence and strength after surgery or illness.
recovery.intro: After staying in hospital for a considerable length of time, the thought of returning home can trigger anxiety. It is normal to worry about how you will manage without the support of hospital staff. Physiotherapy plays a huge part in helping you on a speedy route to recovery.

contentSections.heading: Preparing for Discharge
contentSections.body: Before leaving the hospital, it is important to have a clear discharge plan. This plan should include information about medications, follow-up appointments, and any necessary medical equipment. Communicating with healthcare providers to understand the recovery process and expected timeline is essential.

contentSections.heading: Managing Medications
contentSections.body: Proper medication management is crucial for recovery. Ensure that you understand the dosage, timing, and potential side effects of any prescribed medications. Setting reminders and keeping a medication schedule can help avoid missed doses and ensure adherence to the treatment plan.

contentSections.heading: Our top tips to help you progress at home
contentSections.body: Assess your capabilities and plan you a personalised physiotherapy programme to help you reach your goals. Discuss your lifestyle and advise on how to achieve normality. Look for any muscle weakness, joint stiffness, or balance issues and work on addressing them. Assess your abilities to sit, stand, walk, and climb the stairs in your own home. Review walking aids and check that they are suitable for you.

jointpain.title: Joint and Muscular Pain
jointpain.metaTitle: Expert Joint and Muscular Pain Treatment | Movement Science
jointpain.metaDescription: Effective management and treatment for back, neck, and joint pain. Personalised physiotherapy plans to help you live pain-free.
jointpain.intro: Joint and muscular pain can significantly affect one's quality of life, limiting mobility and causing discomfort. Understanding the causes and treatment options for these types of pain is crucial for managing symptoms and improving overall well-being.

contentSections.heading: Common Causes
contentSections.body: Joint pain can stem from conditions like osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, bursitis, or gout. Muscular pain can result from strain, overuse, or tension. Identifying the specific cause is key to effective management.

contentSections.heading: Treatment Options
contentSections.body: We use a combination of manual therapy, guided exercises, and lifestyle advice. Our goal is to reduce inflammation, improve joint function, and strengthen supporting muscles.

balance.title: Balance and Mobility
balance.metaTitle: Improve Balance and Mobility | Movement Science Physiotherapy
balance.metaDescription: Specialist physiotherapy to improve balance, prevent falls, and increase mobility in your daily life.
balance.intro: Maintaining good balance and mobility is essential for independence and safety, especially as we age. Our specialist team helps you identify risks and build confidence in your movement.

contentSections.heading: Our Method
contentSections.body: We conduct thorough balance assessments and design personalised exercise programmes. We look at muscle strength, joint flexibility, and proprioception to create a comprehensive plan.

muscularweak.title: Muscular Weakness
muscularweak.metaTitle: Treatment for Muscular Weakness | Movement Science
muscularweak.metaDescription: Regain your strength and vitality. We provide specialist physiotherapy for muscle weakness and atrophy.
muscularweak.intro: Muscular weakness can be frustrating and limiting. Whether it's due to injury, illness, or aging, our team is here to help you rebuild your strength and confidence.

contentSections.heading: Our Approach
contentSections.body: We use progressive resistance training and neuromuscular re-education to help your muscles fire correctly and grow stronger. Each plan is tailored to your current ability level.

sports.title: Sports Injuries
sports.metaDescription: Get back in the game faster. Specialist sports injury rehabilitation for athletes of all levels.
sports.intro: Don't let a sports injury keep you on the sidelines. Our specialist sports physiotherapists help you recover quickly and prevent future injuries.

contentSections.heading: Expert Rehab
contentSections.body: From acute sprains to chronic overuse injuries, we provide expert diagnosis and evidence-based rehabilitation to ensure a safe and effective return to sport.

falls.title: Falls and Accidents
falls.metaTitle: Falls Prevention & Accident Recovery | Movement Science
falls.metaDescription: Specialist support after a fall or accident. Improve your balance and rebuild your confidence.
falls.intro: A fall can be a major setback, both physically and emotionally. We provide a supportive environment to help you recover and reduce the risk of future incidents.

contentSections.heading: Building Confidence
contentSections.body: After a fall, the fear of falling again can be as limiting as the injury itself. We work on both physical strength and psychological confidence to help you move freely again.

confidence.title: Building Up Your Confidence
confidence.metaTitle: Build Confidence in Your Movement | Movement Science
confidence.metaDescription: Rebuild your physical and mental confidence after injury or illness. Specialist support to help you move freely.
confidence.intro: Confidence is key to recovery. Our holistic approach combines physical rehabilitation with psychological support to help you achieve your full potential.

contentSections.heading: Empowering Movement
contentSections.body: We believe that movement is empowerment. Our programmes are designed to give you the tools and the confidence to take back control of your life.

swelljoints.title: Swollen Joints
swelljoints.metaTitle: Treatment for Swollen & Painful Joints | Movement Science
swelljoints.metaDescription: Relieve joint swelling and inflammation. Specialist physiotherapy for arthritis and acute joint issues.
swelljoints.intro: Swollen joints can be painful and restrictive. We provide expert care to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and restore joint function.

contentSections.heading: Reducing Inflammation
contentSections.body: Through manual therapy, lymphatic drainage techniques, and bespoke exercise, we target the root cause of swelling to get you moving comfortably again.

working.title: Returning To Work
working.metaTitle: Occupational Health & Return to Work | Movement Science

working.intro: Returning to work is a major milestone. We provide the rehabilitation and ergonomic advice you need to ensure a successful and sustainable return.

contentSections.heading: Work-Ready Rehab
contentSections.body: We simulate work-related tasks and provide ergonomic assessments to prepare your body for the demands of your job, ensuring you go back stronger.

outdoors.metaTitle: Outdoor Mobility & confidence training | Movement Science
outdoors.metaDescription: Master uneven terrain and outdoor environments. We help you regain the confidence to enjoy the outdoors safely.
outdoors.intro: The world isn't flat, and neither is your journey. We help you master steps, slopes, and uneven ground so you can enjoy the outdoors with confidence.

contentSections.body: Our therapy sessions can include real-world outdoor practice. We help you navigate your local community safely, whether it's the park, the shops, or different public spaces.

mobilediff.title: Mobility Difficulties At Home
mobilediff.metaTitle: Improve Home Mobility | Movement Science Physiotherapy
mobilediff.metaDescription: Specialist support for mobility issues at home. We help you navigate your living space safely and independently.
mobilediff.intro: Your home should be a place of safety and comfort. We help you overcome mobility challenges within your living space, from stairs to bathroom safety.

contentSections.heading: Home Safety Solutions
contentSections.body: We assess your home environment and provide tailored exercises to improve your safety and independence in daily tasks like getting in and out of bed or climbing stairs.
